exposure: type of delivery (caesarean section, spontaneous vaginal delivery)
delivery service by the provider of their preference
cohort: 319 postnatal mothers at Tirunesh Beijing General Hospital in 2021
finding: The overall prevalence of respectful maternity care was 87.8%, but type of delivery, getting delivery service by the provider of their preference, stillbirth, and sex of delivery attendant were associated factors.
mod_finding: Caesarean section (adjusted odds ratio = 10.4, 95% confidence interval: (1.8, 61) and spontaneous vaginal delivery (adjusted odds ratio = 2.9, 95% CI: 1.4, 6) were associated with respectful maternity care.
